scripts.version: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version; fs.writeFileSync('src/version.js', 'export const version = \'' + v + '\';\n'); })" && git add src/version.js
scripts.postversion: git push && git push --tags && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --generate-notes
